notes.title: Announcement of Game Operation Suspension
notes.notes:
Dear players:
We are very sorry to inform you that due to the fact that our server lease will expire soon and we are unable to afford the new server rental fees, the game will soon be inaccessible for login. We will stop the in-game payment service. The in-game currency that has already been purchased can still be used without any impact. We wish you all a pleasant gaming experience.
